section.sectionSummaryBrief: The vessel for these two matters is the unity of Israel in two modes, which also applies to individual divine service and prepares for the true redemption through Moshiach.
section.t: And the vessel for these two matters is the unity of Israel in two modes.
That each one receives from his fellow,
and that all of Israel are one structure.
And likewise in the individual service of each and every one,
that there are these two matters in it.
The service of the ten powers of his soul
(which are analogous to the ten categories from your heads, your tribes, until the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water54)
in a manner that all the powers receive from each other and complete each other,
and the service from the aspect of Yechidah, which is above division.
And this is also a proximate preparation for the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteousness,
for the matter of Moshiach is Yechidah55.
And this is that in every Jew there is a spark of Moshiach56,
that the particular Yechidah in each and every Jew is a spark of the general Yechidah of Moshiach
that in each and every Jew there is the aspect of Moshe within him58],
he will come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
in the true and complete redemption speedily, literally.
